summary: This class manages visual pop-up effects (likely for UI notifications) in the game.  It spawns a pop-up with an icon, text, and optional tracking of a target Transform. The pop-up's lifecycle includes spawning, updating its position (potentially following a target), and recycling for reuse.  It's designed to be efficient by recycling instances instead of constantly creating new ones. The effect is tied to the active world, ensuring it's only visible when relevant.

keyMethods.name: Recycle
keyMethods.description: Resets the PopFX instance to its initial state, releasing it back to a pool managed by PopFXManager for reuse.  Clears references, sets flags, and deactivates the GameObject.

keyMethods.name: Spawn
keyMethods.description: Spawns a new pop-up effect. Takes an icon, text, optional target transform for tracking, offset, lifetime, and tracking flag as parameters. It calculates the initial position, subscribes to world change events, and sets the effect's active state.

parameters.name: Icon
parameters.description: The sprite to display as the icon.

parameters.name: TargetTransform
parameters.description: Optional. If provided, the pop-up will track this transform's position.

parameters.name: Offset
parameters.description: Offset from the target or starting position.

parameters.name: LifeTime
parameters.description: The lifespan of the effect in seconds. Defaults to 1.5f.

parameters.name: TrackTarget
parameters.description: Whether to track the target transform. Defaults to false.

keyMethods.name: OnActiveWorldChanged
keyMethods.description: Handles world change events. Updates the PopFX's active state based on the active world ID.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: A Tuple containing world IDs (likely old and new).

keyMethods.name: SetWorldActive
keyMethods.description: Sets the active state of the PopFX based on whether it's in the currently active world. Uses Grid.WorldIdx to determine world ID based on cell position.

parameters.name: worldId
parameters.description: The ID of the world to check against.

keyMethods.name: Update
keyMethods.description: Updates the pop-up's position and alpha value over time.  If tracking a target, the position follows the target; otherwise, it remains at its starting position.  The effect fades out as its lifetime approaches.

keyProperties.name: Speed
keyProperties.description: The speed at which the pop-up moves vertically.

keyProperties.name: IconDisplay
keyProperties.description: Unity UI Image component for displaying the icon.

keyProperties.name: TextDisplay
keyProperties.description: Localized text component for displaying the text.

keyProperties.name: canvasGroup
keyProperties.description: Unity UI CanvasGroup for controlling the effect's alpha.

keyProperties.name: lifetime
keyProperties.description: The total lifetime of the effect in seconds.

keyProperties.name: lifeElapsed
keyProperties.description: Elapsed time since the effect started.
